## Research themes

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .theme-card}
### Contested Authority & violence
How communities respond to insurgency and crime when the state is weak or absent? Self-defense networks, insurgent legitimacy, and informal order, drawing on Peru's 1980–2000 conflict.

[Read the paper →](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167268119304135){.stretched-link .card-cue}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .theme-card}
### Political institutions & growth
Whether authoritarian rule actually delivers economic gains, reassessing Chile's "miracle" under Pinochet and the democratic transition.

[Read the paper →](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/latin-american-research-review/article/influence-of-pinochet-on-the-chilean-miracle/4DB3D0E252A7B70AC00E1AEC7E3F6A20){.stretched-link .card-cue}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .theme-card}
### Development economics
How formal and informal institutions shape state capacity, fiscal capacity, and long-run development in low- and middle-income countries.

[Read the paper →](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0305750X25003444){.stretched-link .card-cue}
:::
:::
